use: epic bosses such as huge dragons, up to 29 m tall / 31 m long

idle.note: Standing at rest, slow breathing and a small weight shift; F6 flows back into F1.

walk.note: Walking loop in place (the game moves the sprite); F6 flows into F1.

run.note: Running loop in place, leaning into the run; F6 flows into F1.

jump.note: Jump. Keep the body near the ground line: the game lifts the sprite, the frames only change the pose.

fly.note: Flying loop, one full wingbeat. The game sets the altitude; draw the lowest point (feet or tail) just above the ground line.

fly_fast.note: Fast flight: body stretched out flat, hard short wingbeats.

float.note: Gliding above the ground line without walking; trailing cloth and hair ripple through one loop.

float_fast.note: Fast glide: leaning hard forward, everything streaming behind.

slither.note: Serpent locomotion: an S-curve wave travels down the body each loop.

slither_fast.note: Fast serpent surge: tighter, quicker waves, head held low.

talk.note: Talking loop: head and hand gestures, feet planted.

melee.note: Melee attack; damage lands on F4.

heavy.note: Slow heavy attack with a long, readable wind-up; damage lands on F5.

leap.note: Leaping attack: the game moves the creature forward and up; damage lands on F4 as it comes down.

cast.note: Spell: magic gathers in F1-F3 and the projectile leaves on F4. Magic is solid pixels with a hard edge (STYLE_GUIDE §4).

shoot.note: Bow shot: the arrow leaves on F4 (the game spawns the arrow sprite).

throw.note: Throw: the thrown object leaves the hand on F4 (the game spawns it).

breath.note: Breath attack: the game plays F4-F5 in a loop while it breathes. Paint only the glow in the mouth; the game draws the breath stream.

roar.note: Roar / taunt: head up, jaws wide on F3-F4.

summon.note: Summoning: the minions appear on F4 (the game spawns them).

blink.note: Teleport: the body breaks into hard-edged ordered-dither and magic in F1-F2, F3 is only a few sparks, F4-F6 reform. No soft transparency.

block.note: Block: guard raised, braced on F3-F4.

takeoff.note: Take-off (its jump): crouch, wings up, spring on F3; the game lifts it.

land.note: Landing: wings flare, feet touch on F4.

hurt.note: Pain flinch: knocked back on F1-F2, recovers to the idle pose by F6.

death.note: Death: collapses onto the ground line. F6 is held, then swapped for the corpse, so F6 must match the corpse sheet in the same direction.
